title: 4H-4-arylbenzopyran compound preparation method
abstract: The invention discloses a 4H-4-arylbenzopyran compound preparation method. According to the method, triethylenetetramine-beta-cyclodextrin is adopted as a catalyst; aromatic aldehyde, malononitrile and resorcinol are adopted as raw materials; water is adopted as a solvent; and a reaction is carried out under a temperature of 15-30 DEG C. When the reaction is finished; separation purification is carried out through washing or with a silica gel column, such that a target product is obtained. The method has the characteristics of simple and feasible operations, mild reaction conditions, and low reagent price. The method is green and highly efficient, and has a good application prospect.
